name: create_danmaku_report
description: Persist a private HTML report from the frozen selected sources. For VIDEO-only reports, pass the video evidence_id alone; never query feedback to create that artifact. For feedback reports, classify the selected text sources completely; no model calls occur inside this tool. For classification returned by query_danmaku, submit current offset and topics_json: an array or {"topics":[...]} containing {topic_key:T1..T100,title,observation,recommendation,sample_ids,optional video_context,optional video_at_ms}. Submit at most 10 topics and no more topics than the current batch contains groups. Assign EVERY current batch G1/G2/... ID exactly once; sample_ids means all members, not examples. Empty sample_ids arrays are ignored; duplicate IDs are kept only in their first submitted topic; omitted IDs go into a visible “other discussion” topic with their original audience quotes retained. Reuse topic_key across batches and update its prose using prior conclusions plus current feedback. Include video_evidence_id only when VIDEO is selected (then it is required), and connect at least one first-batch topic to actual video frames using video_context and video_at_ms. video_at_ms MUST be an integer array of 1-4 actual sampled positions (for one anchor use [1320], never 1320). If the video cannot confirm a viewer claim, say so rather than inventing facts. Before LLM processing the server compresses exact duplicate texts with the same source, author role, playback position and reply context, retaining every original ID and occurrence. Classify only the returned representative G IDs; the server expands membership to every original record. Batches contain at most 40 distinct expressions, not 40 raw records. Server saves the draft, computes exact counts and returns the next full batch. The LAST batch automatically renders and delivers the HTML report; earlier batches do not finish the run. A report cannot be produced with unread or unclassified text. For zero messages, pass evidence_id only. Legacy data without audience uses sections_json with up to 6 observations and 1-4 legacy sample IDs each. For query_audience evidence, reuse stable topic_key T1..T100 across batches. The server accumulates topic memberships, counts and video anchors in code and automatically publishes after the last complete batch. Do not request an extra merge or skill resource. Do not infer audio from frames; viewer audio feedback must remain attributed to the viewer.
